title: CO2 methanation reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed thermal-catalyst family for Sabatier methanation screening. These candidates compare a defensible nickel baseline with lower-temperature ruthenium-led routes that matter for power-to-gas and compact methanation systems.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent pricing anchors and more reproducible preparation routes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2019
citations.note: Selective light-absorber-assisted single-Ni-atom route demonstrating efficient low-energy CO2 methanation without moving to a noble-metal basis.

citations.label: Nature Catalysis 2024
citations.note: Au-Ru/CeO2 route linking metal-support and photothermal effects to lower-temperature CO2 methanation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Ru/MnO-Mn3O4 photothermal catalyst reporting strong solar-assisted methanation performance and route-specific support engineering.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Layered sodium titanate supported ruthenium route for ambient-pressure CO2 methanation, highlighting low-temperature activity at the cost of a noble-metal basis.

citations.label: Catalysis Today 2013
citations.note: Aldana, Ocampo et al.: operando IR mechanistic study of CO2 methanation on Ni-based ceria-zirconia, implicating formate and carbonyl intermediates.

citations.label: Journal of Catalysis 2015
citations.note: Mutz, Carvalho et al.: structural response of a Ni-based methanation catalyst under fluctuating reaction conditions unraveled by operando XAS/Raman/IR.

citations.label: ACS Catalysis 2017
citations.note: Mutz, Belimov et al.: alumina-supported Ni3Fe alloy with stable activity for CO2 methanation; alloying improves resistance to deactivation under load swings.

citations.label: Fuel 2016
citations.note: Roensch et al.: review of methanation from fundamentals to current SNG projects, covering Ni-based catalysts, reactor concepts, and process integration.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2018
citations.note: Guo, Mei, Yuan et al.: low-temperature CO2 methanation over CeO2-supported Ru single atoms, nanoclusters and nanoparticles, comparing how active-site geometry tunes the selectivity-activity trade-off.

citations.label: Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 2012
citations.note: Ni/CeO2 reaches near-equilibrium CO2 conversion from 300 C with ~100% CH4 selectivity, clearly ahead of Ni/alpha-Al2O3.

citations.label: Catal. Today 2013
citations.note: Operando-IR mechanism on Ni/ceria-zirconia: low-temperature methanation runs through formates on the ceria surface.

route_templates.name: Ni oxide-support methanation route
synthesis: Slurry mixing or incipient wetness loading
route_templates.route_note: Most defensible commercial screening route for Sabatier methanation and the easiest starting point for plant-scale reasoning.

route_templates.name: Ru-MnOx photothermal methanation route
route_templates.route_note: Useful when compact low-temperature methanation matters, but noble-metal accounting and photothermal support design lower route maturity.

route_templates.name: Ru layered-titanate methanation route
route_templates.route_note: Highest low-temperature promise in the family, but nanoconfined Ru handling and layered-support reproducibility remain less mature.

candidates.title: Ni/Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Conventional supported-nickel Sabatier basis for CO2 methanation screening.
decision_notes: Best fit when a defensible non-noble commercial screening anchor matters more than the lowest possible light-off temperature.
Nickel still dominates the economic case even when advanced literature routes outperform it per active site.

pricing.note: Live nickel feed with precursor conversion markup.
2025 USGS alumina import value used as a bulk oxide support proxy.

candidates.title: Ru/MnOx photothermal route
candidates.summary: Ruthenium on manganese-oxide family targeting lower-temperature photothermal CO2 methanation.
decision_notes: Useful when lower reaction temperature or solar-assist compatibility matters enough to justify a noble-metal premium.
Photothermal and manganese-oxide route discipline reduce the maturity score versus the nickel baseline.

pricing.note: Indexed ruthenium feed with precursor conversion markup.

pricing.evidence_label: UN Comtrade manganese-dioxide import unit value
pricing.note: 2024 U.S. imports of HS 282010 (manganese dioxide): $14.69M / 5.61M kg = $2.62/kg CIF; the MnOx term is carried on the MnO2 basis.

candidates.title: Ru/layered titanate route
candidates.summary: Layer-confined Ru route emphasizing ambient-pressure and lower-temperature CO2 methanation.
decision_notes: Strong candidate when the design target is ambient-pressure or much lower-temperature methanation rather than lowest catalyst cost.
Layered titanate confinement improves the performance score but keeps route reproducibility below industrial nickel practice.

pricing.note: Indexed ruthenium feed with precursor conversion markup.
Layered sodium titanate support cost held on an engineering proxy until a public bulk basis is curated.

candidates.title: Ni/CeO2 low-temperature route
candidates.summary: 10 wt% nickel on ceria reaches near-equilibrium Sabatier conversion from 300 C with essentially complete methane selectivity - the base-metal answer to low-temperature duty.
decision_notes: Same impregnation chain as the alumina baseline with the support upgraded to a public-priced reducible oxide.
Wins low-temperature duty without paying for ruthenium; ceria supply risk is the watch item.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with a mild precursor conversion markup; 10 wt% loading is source-quoted.
2025 USGS cerium-oxide price used as a bulk support proxy.
